case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client, objective, quantified $716K savings, and multiple documented proof points are all present—sufficient for a robust case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: Women’s-health platform captures $716K in annual savings and 3.2× ROI within six months through Treya’s strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Advantia Health’s rapid roll-up of OB-GYN practices left it with a fragmented supplier base, inconsistent pricing, and no dedicated procurement function. With private-equity backers expecting near-term EBITDA lift, leadership needed to uncover and realize meaningful cost reductions without disrupting clinical operations. Limited spend visibility and disparate AP systems made in-house efforts impractical, prompting Advantia to partner with Treya Partners.
approach_summary: Performed data-driven spend analysis across 10 target categories—$19M in addressable spend—to prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Benchmarked and renegotiated Athenahealth revenue-cycle fees, lowering the take-rate from 3.39 % to 3.15 % while avoiding a $9M termination penalty.
Ran competitive RFPs and leveraged GPO pricing to consolidate medical-supply distribution, switching Heartland clinics to McKesson and extending payment terms to 60 days.
Modeled insourcing scenarios for sonography services, implementing an in-house recruiter strategy projected to reduce costs by 19 %.
Drove quick-win process changes—five-unit IUD order minimums and Bayer replacement program enrollment—delivering savings just 45 days after kickoff.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya unlocked $716,395 in annual run-rate savings—already banking $532,821—and positioned another $183,574 to close shortly, comfortably exceeding the client’s $450K guarantee. The savings represent more than 3.2× Treya’s fixed fee and began accruing less than two months into the engagement. Beyond the dollars, Advantia now benefits from standardized purchasing policies, extended supplier payment terms, and a repeatable sourcing playbook to sustain value creation.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first measurable savings within 45 days, accelerating value realization.
Combined deep healthcare sourcing expertise with benchmark data to negotiate savings without costly platform changes (e.g., Athenahealth).
Balanced rigor and pragmatism—implemented insourcing and distributor switches while maintaining uninterrupted patient care.
Exceeded the 2× savings-to-fee guarantee by 59 %, proving out Treya’s results-oriented model.
